title: Stood
html_source: Nurse Callan asked them to quieten down as there was a woman in labor above them.

anchor.prefix:
nd his neighbour nist not of his wile. And he sat down in that castle with them for to rest him there awhile. Thanked be Almighty God. 

1932#350

 This meanwhile this good sister
anchor.suffix: by the door and begged them at the reverence of Jesu our alther liege Lord to leave their wassailing for there was above one quick with child, a gentle dame, whose time hied fast.
